visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A medium shot shows a large light brown dog with a green harness sitting next to a toddler girl on a grassy patch. The girl has pigtails and is wearing a white sweatshirt with a cream-colored knit scarf. (2) The scene cuts to a full shot of an adult woman in a beige sweatshirt walking the dog on a leash and holding the girl's hand on an outdoor asphalt road. (3) A close-up focuses on the dog's face as it yawns widely while standing on the road. The toddler is seen walking slowly in the background. (4) The girl stops walking to look at the ground, showing her green dinosaur backpack. The dog and the woman wait patiently beside her under bright daylight. (5) The girl crouches down and sits on a concrete ledge next to the path. The dog stands and yawns again, looking towards the camera. (6) The girl remains seated while the dog sits down on the pavement next to her. The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring white brand text.
